nodes.label: addSelect() Subqueries Pattern
nodes.rationale: Use correlated subqueries via addSelect() to fetch single values from has-many relationships without extra queries.

nodes.label: Dynamic Relationships via Subquery FK
nodes.rationale: Extend addSelect() to fetch a foreign key via subquery, then define a belongsTo relationship on that virtual attribute.

nodes.label: Conditional Aggregates
nodes.rationale: Replace multiple count queries with a single query using CASE WHEN inside selectRaw().

nodes.label: setRelation() for Circular N+1
nodes.rationale: Inject already-loaded parent models into children to prevent redundant queries.

nodes.label: whereIn Subquery over whereHas
nodes.rationale: whereIn with a subquery is often more index-friendly than correlated EXISTS subqueries emitted by whereHas().
